description: Temporal entry and cost checkpoint fixture; not evidence of profitability.
original_text: Arm a long setup when completed return_5m_bps reaches 20. On either of the next two completed minutes, confirm a pullback return_1m_bps from -20 through -2 with positive sma_gap_bps. Reset when sma_gap_bps is non-positive, any referenced input is unknown, setup expires, or observed bars skip. One position, no adds, 20% sizing, SL40/TP90, no authored max hold. Admission deadline only blocks new entries. At the first new completed bar after180 seconds from actual first fill, close if gross executable-side gain is below the ex-ante entry cost hurdle. UNKNOWN checkpoint costs defer this checkpoint. This is a mechanical example and must not be attributed to Sol/Astra or used as evidence of edge.
